# Dailymotion

> Dailymotion is a video hosting and streaming platform offering solutions for e-learning, live streaming, and video management across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and 4K formats.

Dailymotion provides comprehensive video solutions for content creators, educators, and enterprises. The platform emphasizes privacy, security, and compliance while delivering advanced video management, analytics, and player technology.

## Key Topics

- Video Hosting
- E-learning Solution
- Live Streaming
- Video Management
- Analytics
- Dailymotion Player
- 4K Support
- Mobile (iOS/Android)
- Privacy & Security
- Educational Content
- Video Integration
- Child Safety
- Copyright Protection
- Terms of Use
- Cookie Policy

## Solutions & Products

- [Our Solutions](https://pro.dailymotion.com/en/solutions/): Overview of Dailymotion's video solutions across industries and sectors
- [E-learning](https://pro.dailymotion.com/en/solutions/e-learning/): Dailymotion e-learning solution for video hosting and educational content delivery
